newsitem.title: UK: Rolls Royce up on talk of power unit deal.
newsitem.headline: Rolls Royce up on talk of power unit deal.

text.p: Shares in engineering group Rolls Royce Plc advanced on Monday helped by a weekend press report which said the company was making progress in the planned disposal of its Parsons turbine unit.

The shares were 6p higher at 239p by 0852 GMT, in volume of 1.5 million shares. The Sunday Times newspaper said German engineering group Siemens AG was in talks with Rolls Royce about the possible purchase of the turbine business. The newspaper added that Siemens could also take control of the switchgear and transformer businesses as part of the deal.
"Rolls Royce have indicated clearly that they are selling the turbine unit, it has been ongoing since September," said Andy Chambers, engineering analyst at SocGen.

"Essentially they were running the business down in the absence of it being sold so it's good news that they may be coming close to a deal," he added. Parsons has also been cited as a possible target of U.S. company General Electric.

"The switchgear business though has previously been indicated as being retained, but from a shareholder value point of view if they were to get better value by selling it they would do so, at a price," Chambers said.
